fixture: Private PostgreSQL cluster bound to loopback, C locale, plain local DB connections, maintained browser and authorization provisioning functions from scripts/test-local.py, ordinary Phoenix/Bandit endpoint, synthetic provider and compiled console client.
runner_deviation: The full scripts/test-local.py runner stopped at its repository-wide format preflight because the integration base's check-configured-startup.exs is unformatted. A private harness called the maintained provisioning functions and ran the selected ExUnit modules directly. Both changed Elixir files passed mix format --check-formatted.

baseline.product_source: integration base, with the new regression test
baseline.observation: GET /auth/session returned 200 before provisioning and 503 after applying the checked-in provisioning SQL and starting the uploader pool.

candidate.observation: GET /auth/session returned 200 and emitted a usable cookie with grants absent, with the installed uploader enabled, and after restarting with upload default-off and the grants retained. The enabled pool used session_user mixer_artifact_uploader. No uploader pool ran in the default-off restart.

refusals.observation: Each variant returned 503 and emitted no cookie. The restored exact shape returned 200 and emitted a usable cookie.

cleanup: Both measured PostgreSQL postmasters exited, owned process groups were absent, ports were reusable, and owned data directories were removed.
scope: Local browser session and uploader startup coexistence with exact browser relation ACL admission. This run did not perform a signed artifact upload, exercise PostgreSQL TLS or PostgreSQL 16, or qualify a release.
